svg.title: tl-syntax checks a formula and a signal catalog
svg.desc: A node table of 2 nodes and a semantic profile, mltl.closed-trace/v1, go into Formula::new, which returns a borrowed Formula or the first FormulaError. A signal catalog of 3 signals and 1 binding goes into SignalCatalog::new, which returns a SignalCatalog or the first SignalCatalogError. bind_formula joins the two into a BoundFormula when every proposition has a binding to a Boolean signal. The crate defines 4 semantic profiles.

g.data-text: signal catalog: 1 request_ready boolean; 2 retry_count integer 0..8; 3 temperature fixed decimal -400..1250 scale 1
node table: n0 proposition 1; n1 future [1,2] of n0
bind_formula: all bound to BoundFormula: formula + catalog: then (call) (call relation)
bindings: 1 proposition to Boolean signal to SignalCatalog::new: ids, names, targets: then (call) (call relation)
signal catalog: 1 request_ready boolean; 2 retry_count integer 0..8; 3 temperature fixed decimal -400..1250 scale 1 to SignalCatalog::new: ids, names, targets: then (call) (call relation)
SignalCatalog::new: ids, names, targets to SignalCatalogError: then (call) (call relation)
SignalCatalog::new: ids, names, targets to SignalCatalog: borrowed view: then (call) (call relation)
SignalCatalog: borrowed view to bind_formula: all bound: then (call) (call relation)
Formula: borrowed view to bind_formula: all bound: then (call) (call relation)
Formula::new: order, profile fit to Formula: borrowed view: then (call) (call relation)
Formula::new: order, profile fit to FormulaError: first bad node: then (call) (call relation)
node table: n0 proposition 1; n1 future [1,2] of n0 to Formula::new: order, profile fit: nodes (call) (call relation)
semantic profile: mltl.closed-trace/v1 to Formula::new: order, profile fit: profile (call) (call relation)
